name: Kdtree-based Iso-surface Extraction
definition: A method for extracting iso-surfaces from scalar fields using a hierarchical K-d tree structure built upon an octree, utilizing QEF for vertex optimization and clusterability checks for simplification.
summary: Kdtree-based Iso-surface Extraction extracts iso-surfaces from scalar fields using a K-d tree hierarchy built on an octree, distinguishing itself by explicitly using this tree structure to guide traversal and subdivision.
